run_sample_goal: run the rearrange_dice CLI with sample_goal to output a random goal as JSON
run_goal_from_config: run the rearrange_dice CLI with goal_from_config to load a goal from a JSON config file
run_create_pattern_template: run the rearrange_dice CLI with create_pattern_template to output an ASCII goal pattern template
run_parse_goal_pattern: run the rearrange_dice CLI with parse_goal_pattern to parse an ASCII goal pattern file into JSON
review_main: review the rearrange_dice CLI main function and its argparse subparser setup for all four commands
